content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 1 for Research Assistant and 3 for Field Data Collector.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Assistant: Graduate in science with two-year experience in health-related research project OR Post-graduation degree in life science/ Biological science (MSc, MPH etc.). Field Data Collector: 12th passed in science subjects OR 12th passed with one-year experience in Health-related research.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum age limit is 30 years. Age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Women/Differently abled candidates. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Research Assistant: Rs. 30,000/- per month Field Data Collector: Rs. 25,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 06-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 06-09-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Assistant and Field Data Collector posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for these positions. One vacancy is for the Research Assistant post, and three are for the Field Data Collector post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: For the Research Assistant role, candidates must be graduates in science with two years of experience in a health-related research project, or possess a post-graduation degree in life science/biological science (MSc, MPH etc.).

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the Field Data Collector post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Field Data Collector position, candidates should have passed 12th grade in science subjects or be 12th passed with one year of experience in health-related research.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these recruitment posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 30 years. However, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/OBC/Women/Differently abled candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an age relaxation of 5 years for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/Women/Differently abled categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Research Assistant and Field Data Collector?
faq.answer: The selected Research Assistant will receive a salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month, while the Field Data Collector will be paid Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to send their completely filled application form along with all necessary documents as a single, consolidated scanned PDF via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a written exam, an interview, or a combination of both, depending on the discretion of the selection committee.
